title: Measurement and Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement. It proposes a conceptual framework (measurement modeling) for understanding and evaluating fairness in computational systems but does not apply it to religion or faith.
models_tested: Correctional Offender Management Profiling for Alternative Sanctions (COMPAS)
findings: This paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on applying measurement theory from the social sciences to fairness in computational systems, using examples from education, criminal justice, and healthcare.
